subject.title: feat(feishu): embed image media in card sends

question: Should this PR be narrowed to action-level card plus one media item, or must it implement the linked issue's agent-facing sendPayload path with multiple image attachments before merge?
rationale: The code change is plausible for a smaller action feature, but it does not satisfy the linked feature issue that it would close, and fallback/trigger semantics for Feishu image cards already need owner direction.

options.title: Require payload-path coverage
options.body: Ask the contributor to implement Feishu outbound sendPayload composition for text/presentation plus multiple image attachments before the linked issue can close.

options.title: Accept action-only scope
options.body: Retarget this PR as a smaller action-level improvement, remove the closing relationship, and keep the payload/multiple-image feature tracked separately.

options.title: Pause for owner design
options.body: Hold the PR until the Feishu owner chooses automatic versus opt-in card behavior and fallback policy.

recommendation.title: Require payload-path coverage
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to implement Feishu outbound sendPayload composition for text/presentation plus multiple image attachments before the linked issue can close.

likelyOwner.reason: m1heng is the declared Feishu plugin owner and was pulled into the live PR timeline for this Feishu-specific behavior decision.
